answer: Give every agent one onyx seal bound to a single hardware key, and make each job leave a public signal: a signed receipt of the real work done. A clone army can copy text but cannot copy the seal, so 200 fake identities would need 200 real keys and 200 real jobs, each costing about 50 coins in fees and deposits, or 10,000 coins in total. A zenith audit then re-runs a random 5 percent of receipts; any receipt that fails to replay burns the whole deposit. Forgery costs more than the reward it could steal.
